    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_phoenix_empire exists = global_var:oe_phoenix_empire global_var:oe_phoenix_empire = { has_variable = oe_m9_favour } } add = 5 }

        if = { limit = { oe_ts_charter = yes } add = -40 }
        else = { add = -20 }
    }
    else_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_phoenix_empire exists = global_var:oe_phoenix_empire global_var:oe_phoenix_empire = { var:oe_tsn_issue ?= 2 } }
        if = { limit = { OR = { oe_ts_course_army = yes oe_ts_course_navy = yes } } add = 10 }
        else = { add = -10 }
        if = { limit = { oe_ts_charter = yes } add = -10 }
    }
    else_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_phoenix_empire exists = global_var:oe_phoenix_empire global_var:oe_phoenix_empire = { var:oe_tsn_issue ?= 3 } }
        if = { limit = { oe_ts_charter = yes } add = -10 }
    }
    else_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_phoenix_empire exists = global_var:oe_phoenix_empire global_var:oe_phoenix_empire = { var:oe_tsn_issue ?= 4 } }
        if = { limit = { save_temporary_scope_as = oe_tsn_me has_global_variable = oe_phoenix_empire exists = global_var:oe_phoenix_empire global_var:oe_phoenix_empire = { has_variable = oe_ti_target var:oe_ti_target ?= scope:oe_tsn_me } } add = 20 }
        else_if = { limit = { oe_ts_charter = yes } add = -10 }
    }
}
